interpretation.calibration: household adapter parameters were fitted only on 2010-2017; test years are untouched.
interpretation.prediction: naive_trend, cohort_proxy and reduced_form remain the short-horizon predictive baselines.
interpretation.mechanism: full/no_housing/no_household are aggregate-ASFR mechanism diagnostics, not formal age-marital-parity hazards.
interpretation.causal_counterfactual: not identified; paired intervals quantify predictive differences only.

limitations: Age, marital-status and parity exposure denominators are not available in the frozen panel.
The 2020 test year remains excluded from the primary untouched test because ACS5 housing is a sensitivity input.
